shows.title: Exploring 'The Exorcist' / Columbia River Strangeness
shows.first_half: In the first half, guest host Ryan Wrecker (email) will speak with author Carlos Acevedo about the movie The Exorcist. Acevedo will examine the original possession case that inspired the novel, the national uproar the movie caused, and the dark effects the film had on the American public. In the second half, former wildlands firefighter James Szubski will discuss eyewitness accounts of high strangeness in the Columbia River Gorge.
shows.second_half: 6-10pm PT: Art Bell—Somewhere in Time returns to 8/6/01 when ghost investigators Brendan Cook and Barbara McBeath shared EVPs and possible voices from the Other Side.

shows.title: Global Cattle Mutilation / Mantis Beings
shows.first_half: First Half: Guest host George Knapp speaks with retired police officer Brian Fitzpatrick about his forensic investigation into global cattle mutilation, spanning 30 case files across six continents over 420 years. Fitzpatrick uses the same evidentiary standards he's applied throughout more than two decades of homicide investigation.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Professor David Luke, Ph.D. will discuss his study of those who have seen mantis beings, both while in altered states and in clear, waking consciousness. He'll explain how those who have encountered the insectoid creatures have been profoundly impacted.

shows.title: ET Contact Experiences / Tesla at War
shows.first_half: First Half: Medical doctor Michael Napolitano will discuss his various extraterrestrial contact experiences, including his lifelong connection with the Pleiadeans and a being known as "the lady." He'll also explain his telepathic communication with the Greys during a deep meditation when he was reportedly abducted.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Nikola Tesla historian Dr. Marc J. Seifer, Ph.D. will discuss the untold story of Tesla at war, his particle-beam weapon, and his secret dealings with the Soviet Union and the British Empire. Dr. Seifer will also dive into FDR's interest in Tesla during World War II.

shows.title: Natural Health Remedies / The State of Ufology
shows.guests: Dr. Drew Peterson, Kevin D. Randle
shows.first_half: First Half: Dr. Drew Peterson will discuss wellness and help us to understand that supplementation along with the modern medical model should be implemented in everyday life in order to maintain optimal health.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Retired Army Lieutenant Colonel Kevin D. Randle will discuss the many UFO cases he's investigated and the conclusions he has drawn from his research. He'll talk about the state of ufology today, and what he feels are the real chances of us seeing disclosure anytime soon.

shows.title: Power of Numerology / Supernatural Stories
shows.first_half: First Half: Numerologist Glynis McCants will show us how to identify a person's personality traits as they pertain to numbers. She'll also give us the inside scoop on some of the top stories taking place this summer through the lens of numerology.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Author and podcaster Jim Harold will detail his lifelong interest in the paranormal and share some his latest stories from the world of the strange and unexplained.

shows.title: Money Secrets / Unidentified Submerged Objects
shows.guests: Morgana Rae, Cheryll Jones, Debbie Ziegelmeyer
shows.first_half: First Half: Author Morgana Rae will discuss how and why most people's relationship with money goes far deeper than finances, and how money can reveal our deepest unconscious beliefs about love, worth, safety, power, belonging, visibility, and responsibility. She'll also explore why financial problems can persist despite positive thinking and hard work.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Coast to Coast's investigative reporter Cheryll Jones will play her latest interview with Debbie Ziegelmeyer regarding our oceans and the many underwater mysteries on our planet.

shows.title: Living Vampires / Open Lines
shows.first_half: Guest host Richard Syrett will speak with author Sean Wilde about the living vampire tradition, including magic, cosmology, energy work, and how to differentiate between various types of vampires. Wilde is an occult teacher, ritual specialist, and internationally recognized elder in modern vampire spirituality. Followed by Open Lines—give Richard a call and share whatever's on your mind!
